name: Simul
description: Shows a live, read-only mirror of the page and translates it on your device in Chrome.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; worker-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; require-trusted-types-for 'script'; trusted-types simul-mirror-shell default;
